description: This file defines classes and methods for handling language support commands in a kickstart configuration, including deprecated and removed versions.

classes.name: FC3_LangSupport
classes.description: Handles language support commands for FC3, including parsing and string representation.

classes.name: FC5_LangSupport
classes.description: Deprecated version of FC3_LangSupport, indicating deprecated status.

classes.name: F7_LangSupport
classes.description: Removed version of FC5_LangSupport, indicating removal from the current version.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the class, setting default language and supported locales.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the command, including default language and supported locales.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an option parser for the command.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and sets class attributes accordingly.
